summary: Tessie is a single-token REST API over Tesla vehicle data and commands. Endpoints are VIN-keyed under https://api.tessie.com/vehicles and /{vin}/... The /vehicles list nests the latest live state in a per-vehicle last_state object (display_name, state, vehicle_config, charge_state); /{vin}/state returns a flat Tesla-style state object. Auth is a single access token sent as an Authorization: Bearer header (Token from TESSIE_API_TOKEN).

novel_features.name: assume-vehicle
novel_features.summary: tessie use <name-or-vin> persists an assumed vehicle (matched by display name, VIN, or VIN suffix) to a small mode-600 JSON store beside the config; vehicle state/battery/location/wake subcommands then fall back to that VIN when none is passed. tessie current prints the assumed car.
novel_features.description: Persist an assumed vehicle so later vehicle subcommands target it without repeating a VIN.

commands.use Car: sets the persisted assumed vehicle to the car named Car
commands.vehicle state: with no VIN positional, resolves to the assumed vehicle and returns live state
